title: Early Careers Talent Community
locationText: Coppell, TX, United States; Los Angeles +12 more
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

Early Careers Talent Community

 

Who we are
Fanatics Collectibles is the company behind Topps, the trading card brand founded in 1938. We hold exclusive trading card rights with MLB, the NBA, and the NFL, and partner with leagues and entertainment properties around the world, from the Premier League, UEFA, FIFA, and Formula 1 to UFC, WWE, Star Wars, and Marvel. Our products sell in more than 100 countries. We are a product and technology company, spanning physical cards and collectibles, Fanatics Collect, our digital marketplace and live-commerce platform, and a newly formed Trading Card Games studio in Seattle.

 

The 2027 Internship Program
A paid, in-person, 10-week summer program (June 7 - August 13, 2027) across our U.S. offices. Interns take part in a speaker series, Hobby 101, cohort events, and a peer-mentor program.

 

Potential business areas

• Product

• Licensing

• Athlete Partnerships

• Commercial / Sales

• Marketing & Social Media

• Strategy

• Finance

• Operations

• People

• Trading Card Games (TCG)

• Fanatics Collect (Digital)

Who should join
Students and recent graduates interested in interning or starting a career with us. We prioritize students entering their senior year for internships but welcome all strong candidates. No collecting background is required; we hire for curiosity, skills, and drive, and we value experience from coursework, clubs, athletics, military service, volunteering, employment, and personal projects.

 

What happens next
Share your resume and tell us your areas of interest and preferred cities. You'll receive alerts when matching roles post, invitations to our virtual Opportunity Sessions in October and November, and preparation resources ahead of applications opening. Joining the Talent Community does not create an application; you'll still apply to specific roles when they post.
Internships are in office five days a week. Housing and relocation support are not provided. Compensation, eligibility, and location are confirmed on each official posting.
By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our  Candidate Privacy Policy.

Build production ML/GenAI solutions and lightweight apps delivering sub-second insights.

Prototype and benchmark new algorithms , offering guidance on scalability trade-offs and production-readiness while co-owning model-performance KPIs.

What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a Principal Machine Learning Engineer with these qualifications.

title: Product Manager | Growth
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

As a Product Manager, Growth at Ramp, you’ll drive acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across our product suite. You’ll identify opportunities to help more businesses discover Ramp, get value from our products, and expand their usage over time.

You’ll work closely with engineers, designers, marketers, and data scientists to develop and execute a growth strategy grounded in customer insight and experimentation. Your scope will include core product experiences and partner-led growth channels, with ownership from identifying an opportunity through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions.

You’ll identify opportunities to use AI to help businesses discover relevant Ramp products, reach value faster, and expand their usage over time. You’ll balance rapid experimentation with the accuracy, transparency, and customer trust required when building financial products.

Please note that this Product Management role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at one of our NYC or SF offices at least 2 days/week

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop and execute a growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, helping businesses get more value from Ramp

- Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for a defined growth surface area, from identifying opportunities through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions

- Lead the ideation, development, and launch of growth experiences, including AI-powered approaches to onboarding, product discovery, recommendations, and cross-sell

- Partner with engineering, design, marketing, and data science to deliver high-impact initiatives across core product experiences and partner-led growth channels

The LangSmith team owns and builds LangChain's core platform for observability, evaluation, and production reliability of AI systems. From tracing and annotation to run rules, evaluations, and beyond, this team owns LangSmith end-to-end. If you want to define what great AI observability looks like at production scale, this is where that work gets done.

- Strong understanding of API design and building reliable data services.

- Experience with high-throughput or mission-critical systems.

- Demonstrated ability to optimize backend services for performance and reliability.

- Experience with database systems (Postgres, Redis, Clickhouse), and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate cross-functionally

- Customer centricity and ownership mentality

 

Compensation

Annual salary range: $180,000- $240,000

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. Actual compensation and offerings will vary based on role, level, and location. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations

title: Senior IT Security Specialist (gn)
description: Einleitung Mehr Verantwortung. Mehr Einfluss.  Standort: Hamburger Westen | Hybrid (60% remote) Du hast schon einige Security-Projekte gesehen. Einige liefen genau so, wie sie geplant waren. Andere haben dich vermutlich mehr gelehrt als jede Zertifizierung. Genau deshalb könnte diese Rolle spannend für dich sein. Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen aus einer stark regulierten Branche mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich IT Security. Die Rolle wurde nicht geschaffen, weil Security "auch irgendwie wichtig" ist. Sondern weil der verantwortliche Teamleiter IT-Security mittlerweile so viele Themen verantwortet, dass er einen Teil davon in erfahrene Hände geben möchte. Gesucht wird also niemand, der Tickets bearbeitet oder Häkchen in Audits setzt. Gesucht wird jemand, der Verantwortung übernehmen möchte. Deine Aufgaben Dein Alltag wird sich irgendwo zwischen operativer Security, Cloud Security und Projektarbeit bewegen. Unter anderem geht es um: Security Reviews neuer Systeme, Anwendungen und Technologien Cloud Security im Azure- und GCP-Umfeld Incident Management Weiterentwicklung der Security-Landschaft Bearbeitung von Findings aus Audits Security-Projekte in einem internationalen Umfeld Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur-, Cloud- und Applikationsteams Aktuell entstehen viele neue Themen und Veränderungen. Entsprechend gibt es ausreichend Möglichkeiten, eigene Erfahrungen einzubringen und Dinge mitzugestalten. Dein Profil Uns ist bewusst, dass niemand jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt. Wichtiger ist: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich IT Security Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien und Cloud Security ist ein Must-Have Eigenständig voranget

title: Account Executive - New York City
description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.  

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock , TPG (The Rise Fund) , SoftBank, Glynn Capital , NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As an Account Executive you will be responsible for managing deal cycles from generation through to close. You will be the primary contact with the prospect and have the responsibilities of qualification, demoing, providing technical assistance, and negotiating contracts. We look for people who are curious, confident, and have a high technical aptitude. As an AE you are accountable for the plan to hit your goal and will enjoy the full assistance of the company to make you successful. You will be surrounded by a great team of people from whom you can learn from, that said, we also want to learn from you. Most importantly, we want entrepreneurs.

What you get to do every day

• Work full cycle deals from demo complete to close.

• Research and target companies using prospecting tools.

• Build and manage a pipeline.

• Learn and demonstrate our platform to new prospective customers.

• Negotiate contracts

• Record and document all sales activities in Salesforce.com.

• Successfully utilize all sales tech tools.

What you bring to the role

• You have at least 2 years of work experience in a sales role, preferably at a startup

• You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding your quota

• You love closing deals and helping businesses by delivering a product that has concrete value

• You're solutions oriented- you recognize objections and help your customers see value in our product regardless of their knowledge of our industry

• Extraordinary communication and interpersonal skills - people trust you and get the sense that you are advocating for something in which you believe

• You have experience working with high-velocity sales cycles or selling to small businesses

• You're resilient-you bounce back from setbacks quickly, are resourceful, and find creative ways to get things done

• You're comfortable with a wide range of sales tools, including Salesforce or other CRMs

• You have a passion for solving big problems and having an immediate and positive impact

• Ability to embrace feedback and hold yourself accountable.

• The ability to learn technology basics and apply them to business situations.

 

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Huma

title: Arquitecto Empresarial
description:
No solo buscamos talento, buscamos mentes curiosas que disfruten aprender y transformar el futuro.
Somos tech, somos exigentes y sí, vamos rápido. Pero nadie compite solo. Trabajamos en equipo y si buscas retos que te saquen de la zona cómoda (porque ahí no crece nadie), estás en el lugar correcto. Aquí aprenderás con expertos, participarás en proyectos de alto impacto y estarás siempre un paso adelante en tecnología.
1. Objetivo del Puesto
Liderar la dirección estratégica de la arquitectura corporativa, alineando los objetivos de negocio con un ecosistema tecnológico escalable, moderno y sostenible. Esta posición requiere una visión sistémica, criterio pragmático y alta capacidad de influencia ejecutiva para guiar la toma de decisiones tecnológicas, racionalizar el portafolio de aplicaciones y consolidar el marco de gobierno que habilite la transformación digital de la organización.
2. Responsabilidades Principales

• Estrategia y Hojas de Ruta: Definir, mantener y evolucionar los modelos de estado actual ( As-Is ) y estado objetivo ( To-Be ) a través de los dominios de Negocio, Datos, Aplicaciones y Tecnología.

• Gobierno de Arquitectura: Presidir y estructurar el Comité de Revisión Tecnológica y Arquitectura, definiendo estándares, patrones de referencia y políticas corporativas para los equipos de Arquitectura de Solución.

• Gestión del Portafolio de Aplicaciones (APM): Ejecutar análisis de racionalización para mitigar la deuda técnica, identificar redundancias y priorizar iniciativas de modernización o desincorporación ( decommission ).

• Supervisión y Mentoría Técnica: Guiar el diseño de soluciones de alta complejidad, asegurando el cumplimiento de los lineamientos corporativos y orientando a los equipos de entrega ( Delivery ).

• Evaluación Financiera y de Riesgo: Analizar alternativas de inversión técnica y trade-offs considerando el Costo Total de Propiedad (TCO), el valor aportado al negocio y la gestión de riesgos estratégicos.

• Innovación e Inteligencia Tecnológica: Evaluar la viabilidad técnica y funcional de nuevas tecnologías y plataformas, garantizando su interoperabilidad con las capacidades empresariales existentes.

• Alineación y Narrativa Ejecutiva: Traducir escenarios y conceptos tecnológicos complejos en narrativas de impacto de negocio para facilitar la toma de decisiones ante Comités y líderes C-Level .

3. Requisitos del Perfil
Requisitos No Negociables

• Experiencia: +10 años en el sector tecnológico, con un mínimo de 5 años desempeñando roles directos de Arquitectura Empresarial o liderazgo arquitectónico transversal.

• Gobierno y Marcos Estratégicos: Dominio en el establecimiento de comités de arquitectura, gestión de excepciones y marcos de cumplimiento.

•
Modelado de Arquitectura:

• Experiencia práctica en TOGAF (ADM) y BIZBOK (mapeo de capacidades de negocio).

• Dominio en modelado ArchiMate (capas de Estrategia, Motivación, Negocio, Aplicación y Tecnología).

• Herramientas EAM: Manejo de plataformas de Enterprise Architecture Management como LeanIX, Bizzdesign, ServiceNow o Archi.

•
Especialización Técnica:

• Gestión y racionalización de portafolios de aplicaciones (APM).

• Patrones de integración moderna (APIs y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos).

• Estrategias Cloud, modelos de costo FinOps, Zero Trust Security y Gobierno de Datos.

• Gestión de Stakeholders: Trayectoria comprobable diseñando roadmaps tecnológicos alineados con planes estratégicos de negocio e interactuando directamente con ejecutivos C-Level .

Requisitos Deseables

• Certificación oficial en TOGAF (v9 o v10) o ArchiMate Practitioner .

• Certificación en SAFe (específicamente Lean Portfolio Management - LPM).

• Experiencia en industrias de Consumo Masivo (CPG), Retail o Manufactura.

• Experiencia previa en proyectos de modernización de plataformas legadas (entornos SAP u homólogos).

4. Formación y Competencias Key

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Technical Writer to join our growing team. This role will be responsible for creating and maintaining clear, concise, and accurate technical documentation for our products, ensuring our users and developers have the information and resources they need for success.

As a Senior Technical Writer at Kong Global Inc., you will be responsible for:

- Developing, writing, and editing high-quality technical documentation, including API docs, developer guides, reference documentation, and release notes, for a variety of audiences.

- Collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and other docs writers to gather information, understand product functionality, and ensure documentation accuracy and completeness.

- Conducting thorough research to gather technical information, including interacting with subject matter experts, analyzing product specifications, and testing software.

- Testing to validate documentation content and ensure accuracy.

- Utilizing Command Line Interface (CLI) tools to test and document software features.

- Managing and maintaining existing documentation, including regular updates, revisions, and deprecation of outdated content.

- Implementing and improving documentation processes and standards, including document management and version control using Git.

- Reviewing docs for technical accuracy and adherence to established guidelines.

- Contributing to project planning and project management efforts related to documentation deliverables, ensuring timely and effective execution.

- Actively participating in product management discussions to provide insights and ensure documentation alignment with product strategy.

- Owning documentation strategy for a specific product area - going beyond writing to understand how docs influence adoption, reduce support burden, and surface unmet use cases, then prioritizing content work accordingly.

- Partnering with product and field teams to identify where documentation gaps are blocking user success, and proposing content investments based on user behavior, support tickets, or adoption data rather than just backlog requests.

- 3+ years of experience in technical writing within a software development environment.

- Proven expertise in software documentation, including experience with API documentation and developer guides.

- Understanding of API testing and experience with relevant tools.

- Proficiency with Command Line Interface (CLI).

- Experience or an interest in AI.

- Solid experience with Git for version control and collaboration.

- Demonstrated ability to perform thorough research and synthesize complex technical information.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.

- Experience with documentation maintenance, document management, and document reviewing processes.

- Experience treating a documentation area like a product - setting priorities based on user impact and adoption, not just ticket volume or team requests.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. title: Principal Engineer - Network
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed - we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role:
You will own the IP and optical architecture for CrowdStrike's global backbone, including connectivity to traditional and neocloud providers. You'll set the multi-year roadmap governing its evolution, including traffic engineering strategy, capacity planning, and demand forecasting for the network as a whole. You'll drive the initiatives that matter most to the business, from funding case through implementation and long-term operational stewardship, and act as the senior escalation resource in the 24x7 on-call rotation when an incident exceeds the depth of the engineers already on it.
What You'll Do:
You'll own platform selection for routing and optical hardware, working directly with vendor engineering teams to influence their roadmaps, and engage director- and VP-level stakeholders across datacenter, application, and business teams to keep network strategy ahead of the company's growth. You'll set the direction for network automation and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, GitOps), and for telemetry and analytics strategy, increasingly including frontier and open-weight AI models for tasks like telemetry analysis and automated triage, with sensitive backbone data kept in-house. Part of the role is raising the technical bar of the organization: reviewing senior engineers' designs, setting the standards they build against, and mentoring them toward this level.
What You'll Need:

• US Citizenship or Green Card holder status

• 12+ years designing, building, and operating large-scale backbone networks, with ownership of architecture at global scale

• Deep expertise in IP/MPLS core technologies: IS-IS, MP-BGP, segment

• routing (SR-MPLS/SRv6), PE/P architectures, MPLS-TE, VRFs, DDoS mitigation, CDN

• Deep expertise in optical transport: DWDM, coherent optics (400G/800G), ROADM architectures, amplifier design (EDFA/Raman), dispersion management, alien wavelengths

• Strong grounding in cloud networking: direct connectivity, multi-cloud routing, and hybrid cloud at scale across major hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure) and neoclouds (e.g., CoreWeave, Cerebras)

• Working depth in adjacent infrastructure domains (virtualization, containers, databases, message queuing, large-scale provisioning) sufficient to architect across boundaries

• Proven ability to set, not just execute, network automation and IaC strategy

• Familiarity with applying frontier and open-weight AI models to network operations (e.g., telemetry analysis, automated triage, ChatOps tooling), including self-hosting open-weight models where data sensitivity requires it

• Experience operating or architecting networks within FedRAMP-authorized environments

• Track record

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps , many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

•
Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages ( GyanTV )

•
Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony )

•
Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages ( Agri Lokal )

•
Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs )

•
Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app )

•
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard ( Dostt & Eaze )

•
Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice ( Astro Lokal )
Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform : local-language internet + deep India insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast.
And we're now carrying that same belief beyond India, beginning with our first international, locally-sourced market in the Philippines. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

title: Software Engineer, Model Lifecycle and Signals
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on the Model Lifecycle and Signals team at SpaceXAI, you'll own the bridge between frontier models and every user facingCursor product, used at a scale few teams ever see. You'll decide when we use which model, spot where models go off track and build the guardrails to keep them on it, and shape what the next generation of models should learn.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, data, and product. You'll bring models from preview to production, dig into real-world data to find out what's actually working, and partner with research, inference, product, and data science teams to turn that evidence into better products and better models.

Every improvement you make compounds across our products and every model we ship.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

- Get new frontier models into users' hands the day they're ready, and retire old ones without anyone noticing.

- Evaluate internal and external preview models before launch and give meaningful feedback to the teams building them.

- Build Cursor Router https://cursor.com/docs/cursor-router: decide which model handles each request, balancing quality, speed, and cost at massive scale.

- Build the eyes and ears of the product, and the experimentation platform that puts them to work: signals that show where each model shines, where it goes off track, and what 'better' actually means.

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF

- You're an exceptional engineer with a track record of shipping production systems people rely on. You own problems end to end, and you'd rather automate a painful process than repeat it.

- You've built and operated evaluation, measurement, or model serving systems, such as AI evals, experimentation, ranking/relevance, or routers. You can turn ambiguous "quality" questions into concrete metrics, pipelines, and decisions.

- You're fluent with data and can collaborate effectively with data scientists and researchers.

- You have strong taste and real curiosity about model and agent behavior. You try new models the day they come out and have opinions about where each one shines.

APPLYING

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

title: Senior Marketing Manager, Digital Outreach Strategy & Growth
description:
• Build and own a full digital outreach path for each subsidiary by identifying decision makers for each product, define specific buyer personas for each business sales activity and grow contact lists from verified sources and research.

• Run multi-channel outbound sequences across email, LinkedIn and other social and digital channels, tailored by subsidiaries, with messaging that speaks to a targeted audience.

• Coordinate efforts with email deliverability specialists for all outbound email domains: authentication and IP warming, sender reputation monitoring, inbox placement testing, list hygiene, and compliance with Google, Yahoo, and Microsoft sender requirements, to reach corporate inboxes protected by enterprise filters.

• Systematize a cross-subsidiary strategy that converts M3's proprietary data assets, such as a network of physicians or health-system relationships- into a repeatable pipeline of qualified conversations through referrals and warm introductions.

• Use AI-assisted research and personalization: build account and contact intelligence, generate personalization at scale, test and refine messaging, while maintaining M3 human review and brand standards.

• Partner with the business development and marketing leads of each subsidiary on target account lists, handoff criteria, follow-up cadence, and feedback on message performance;

• Operate designated BU’s technology stack for outreach (sequencing, Sales Navigator,), integrate it with their CRM’s and recommend new or advanced tech tools.

• Report weekly on placement, reply and positive-reply rates, and pipeline sourced by subsidiary and persona, and use the data to retire what does not work and scale what does.

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

• Certifications in email deliverability, sequencing platforms, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator preferred.

• 7+ years in B2B digital outreach, demand generation, or sales development, with at least 3 years owning persona marketing for outbound commercial revenue generation

• Demonstrated success reaching senior decision makers in healthcare, health systems, experience selling recruitment, staffing, or physician placement services strongly preferred.

• Hands-on experience with sequencing platforms (e.g., Outreach, Apollo, HubSpot Sequences), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, contact enrichment and verification tools, deliverability monitoring tools, and CRM integration.

• Experience supporting or consulting for multiple business units, clients or brands with distinct customers.

• Working knowledge of email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), domain and IP warming, reputation monitoring, and inbox placement testing, and of how Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Proofpoint, Mimecast, and similar filters treat outbound mail.

• Ability to identify and verify the true buyer within a target organization (budget owner, decision maker, and influencers), distinguish them from adjacent or easier-to-reach contacts, and hold a disciplined outreach cadence toward that person without defaulting to volume.

• Understanding of how health systems, medical groups, and staffing firms recruit physicians, and who own those decisions

• Strong writing skills: short, specific with the ability to adapt voice by persona and by subsidiary brand.

• Working knowledge of CAN-SPAM, CASL, GDPR/UK GDPR, TCPA, and LinkedIn terms of service as they apply to outbound outreach.

• Ability to use AI tools for research, personalization, and testing, with judgment about accuracy, brand, and disclosure.

• Ability to manage several concurrent programs independently, prioritize across businesses, and report clearly to sales and marketing leaders.

• Analytical fluency with campaign, deliverability, and CRM data; comfortable building simple dashboards.

Benefits:
A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

• Health and Dental

• Life, Accident and Disab

title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. https://www.thetrainline.com/terms/sustainability-faqs Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Machine Learning and AI Team 👋

Machine learning is at the heart of Trainline’s mission to help millions of people make sustainable travel choices every day. Our models and AI agents support customers when journeys go wrong, power search and recommendations across our apps and website, find the best fares through pricing and routing optimisation, personalise the experience with generative AI, and make our digital marketing smarter. Our teams own the full lifecycle from idea to production, and work closely with colleagues across the business to grow the impact of ML and AI at Trainline.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Manager to lead a team of 7 ML engineers and data engineers within our Core Experience pillar, which covers Search, Supply and Commerce. Your team’s work sits at the centre of how customers find, compare and buy their tickets. You’ll be accountable for what your team ships and how it ships it: the quality of the systems, the pace of delivery and the growth of the people building them. You’ll work alongside data scientists, software engineers and product managers. You’ll stay close enough to the technical work to make good calls on architecture, trade-offs and risk. What unites us is curiosity, a love of what we do and a desire to make sustainable travel the easy choice.

In this role, you will... 🚄

- Lead, coach and grow a team of ML and data engineers. That means setting clear expectations, giving regular feedback, managing performance and building an inclusive team where people do their best work

- Hire for the team, shaping the roles we need and running a fair, rigorous interview process

- Own delivery: plan and prioritise with your product partners across Search, Supply and Commerce, unblock the team, and ship ML and AI systems that move measurable customer and business outcomes

- Set the technical direction for your team’s systems, including architecture, build-versus-buy, and knowing when a simpler approach beats a more sophisticated one

- Make sure the team builds well across the whole lifecycle: reliable data pipelines, high-quality features, rigorous offline and online evaluation (including A/B testing), reliable deployment, monitoring and ongoing maintenance

- Lead the team in building production-grade agentic systems, using orchestration harnesses such as LangGraph to design multi-step workflows, tool use and human-in-the-loop controls

- Make evaluation a first-class engineering discipline for LLM and agent work. That means curated eval sets, LLM-as-judge and human review, tracing, regression testing of prompts and agents, and online monitoring of quality, cost and latency

- Set the guardrails for responsible use of AI, covering safety, privacy and clear fallbacks when an agent shouldn’t act on its own

- Raise the bar on engineering practice through code and design reviews, CI/CD, MLOps, observability and on-call

- Build strong relationships with senior leaders

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.
Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require. 

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.

The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.
 
Research Internship
Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.

title: Deployed Engineer, Professional Services
description:
ABOUT US

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Deployed Engineer to join our Professional Services team, working directly with enterprise customers to build reliable, production agents. You'll translate vague enterprise workflows into concrete software specs and guide engineering teams through the resulting solution, or build it for them. You might spend a week designing a customer's agent architecture, a few weeks co-building their evaluation pipeline, or a quarter embedded inside their team shipping alongside their engineers. You are someone who's built real AI systems for production and can defend the technical tradeoffs within them.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Advising: Agent architecture design, evaluation strategy review, and best-practice production guidance.

- Building: Co-build with the customer's engineering team across the full Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) in outcome-scoped engagements.

- Embedding: Serve as a deployed engineer inside the customer's team for extended engagements, operating as a de facto member of their org to ship agent systems directly.

- Agent Engineering: ADLC end-to-end, architecture design, orchestration patterns, evals, custom conversational UIs, and production deployment.

- Applied AI: Post-training, supervised fine-tuning, harness engineering, trace mining, model selection and evaluation methodology.

REQUIREMENTS

- 4+ years of software engineering experience with deep expertise in Python. TypeScript/JavaScript a plus.

- 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production agent systems.

- Strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to confidently articulate architectural decisions to technical stakeholders (engineers, architects, CTOs).

- Strong experience with LangChain/LangGraph/Deep Agents or comparable frameworks, including multi-agent patterns and state management (short and long-term memory).

- Deep familiarity designing and implementing evaluation methodologies for non-deterministic AI systems.

- Comfortable operating across the full spectrum from advisory to embedded delivery.

- Willing to travel up to 20% of the time.

NICE TO HAVE

- Exposure to dataset curation and post-training techniques (SFT, DPO, RLHF) on open-weight models using tools like Axolotl, Unsloth, Hugging Face transformers, or TRL.

- Experience with trace mining to drive continuous improvement loops

LOCATION

Remote

COMPENSATION

$150,000-$270,000 base + equity

Looking to lead technical strategy across the customer journey from Proofs of Value (PoVs) to driving overall adoption? Please check out the Deployed Engineer listing focused on Account Strategy & Solutions.

Requirements • We are hiring for domain modeling judgment and practical AI engineering. Deep expertise in both is rare; strength in one and fluency in the other works. • Eight or more years building production software, including time at staff, principal, or architect scope where other teams depended on what you owned • Practical experience designing ontologies, knowledge graphs, or canonical domain mod

2. Analytics & Report Verification

• Test the business logic and mathematical correctness of aggregations, KPIs, and predictive metrics.

• Ensure that user-facing charts, graphs, and dashboards accurately reflect the underlying data.

• Conduct regression testing on analytics algorithms and reporting features to prevent data drift.

• Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for both APIs and UI dashboards.

• Implement automated data quality checks within the CI/CD pipeline.

• Mock large-scale datasets to simulate edge cases, high volume, and anomalous data.

• Evaluate how the analytics platform handles heavy concurrent user loads and massive data processing spikes.

• Monitor query performance and report latency bottlenecks to the engineering team.

5. Collaboration & Agile Processes

• Partner closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, and Report Developers to understand complex tracking requirements and data models.

• Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives to advocate for quality and testability early in the development lifecycle.

Basic Requirements
Required Technical Skills & Qualifications:

• Experience: 3+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, ideally within a data-intensive, BI, or analytics product environment.

• Database Proficiency: SQL skills (joins, window functions, subqueries) for deep-dive data verification.

• Programming (Advantageous): Proficiency in at least one scripting language (preferably Python or JavaScript) for data manipulation and test automation.

• Data Technologies: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL pipelines.

• Methodology: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development cycles and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).

• AI: AI use is encouraged and actively used to transform our technology stack.

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

• The "Data Mindset": An obsessive attention to detail-you spot a misplaced decimal point or an omitted data row from a mile away.

• Analytical Thinker: Ability to understand complex business logic and translate it into edge-case test scenarios.

• Strong Communicator

Mindler is one of Europe’s leading digital mental health providers, working to make evidence-based therapy accessible to everyone who needs it. In August 2025, we proudly acquired ieso , a pioneer in delivering online NHS talking therapies across the UK.
Ieso holds several NHS contracts across England and Scotland through both typed and video sessions, making it easier for thousands of people to access effective, evidence-based treatment when they need it most.
This role sits within the clinical counselling team of Ieso - subsidiary of Mindler, meaning you’ll be part of a group with a strong track record in innovation, research, and delivering high-quality digital therapy to patients nationwide.
The role
We provide evidence-based Counselling for Depression via video (and sometimes typed sessions) to NHS patients across the UK, from the Orkney Islands to Cornwall. Our mission is to make psychological therapies accessible to those who need them most-without significant waiting times.
What do I need to have:
To join our self-employed affiliate network, you’ll need:

• Active BACP Accreditation

• Proof of CfD Qualification

• Enhanced DBS certificate (to include both barring's: Adults and Children - issued within the past 12 months OR registered with the update service) - we can support you with an application if you do not have this

• Professional Indemnity Insurance (minimum £1 million coverage for Counselling)

• Two satisfactory professional references (e.g., current supervisor and line manager)

• Access to a secure laptop/PC with an auto-lock function (max 5-minute inactivity)

• Personal email address (NHS email addresses cannot be accepted)

**We cannot proceed if you do not have all of the above, the CfD Qualification is mandatory. What can we offer?
As an self-employed therapist, you’ll enjoy a range of benefits, including:

• Flexibility:  Work remotely and structure your caseload around your availability, with a recommended minimum of 5 patients.

• Competitive Pay:  Earn £42 per 60 minute Video session (including holiday pay), with half-pay for DNAs/late cancellations  (up to two per episode of care).

• Professional Development:  Access free world-class CPD sessions, regular high-quality supervision , and opportunities to develop your clinical skills.

• Innovative Digital Care:  Be part of cutting-edge research and digital innovation, shaping the future of mental healthcare.

• Support & Community:  Expect to feel valued and supported, with access to our dedicated Smart Support System, a clinical conference, and a network of like-minded professionals.

If you're passionate about providing high-quality therapy online and want to make a difference in digital mental healthcare, we’d love to hear from you!
👉to start your application today please respond with proof of the above requirements.
Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have any questions-we look forward to welcoming you to our network!

title: Lead / Expert, Ecosystem Growth

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

 

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

 

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me ,  Do the Right Thing , and  Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

 

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

Role Overview

You will join our global Web3 Growth Team and support the global growth and ecosystem development and broader Web3 initiatives .

This is a global role working closely with Product, Business, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams across multiple markets and regions to identify opportunities at the intersection of Web3 and traditional financial assets.

Responsibilities will be carried out in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

 

你将加入全球 Web3 Growth Team，负责支持  Web3 生态方向的全球增长与生态发展 。

这是一个全球性岗位，你将与分布在不同市场和地区的产品、业务、市场及其他职能团队合作，共同探索 Web3 与传统金融资产相关的产品和生态机会。

Define and drive global growth strategies for Web3 products and ecosystem initiatives, supporting user adoption, ecosystem development, and sustainable business growth.

•
Partner with global Product, Business Development, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to identify priority market and ecosystem opportunities.

与全球 Product、Business Development、Marketing 及其他跨职能团队合作，识别重点市场和生态机会。

建立并维护与相关行业参与者、项目方、技术及生态合作伙伴的关系，推动具有战略价值的合作。

•
深入理解用户需求和市场趋势，为产品定位、用户体验及增长策略提供建议。

•
支持新产品、新市场及生态项目的 go-to-market 和增长计划。

持续跟踪 RWA、资产数字化及 Web3 行业发展，将市场洞察转化为业务和产品机会。

通过数据和用户洞察持续评估项目效果，并优化相关增长策略。

独立推动跨地区、跨团队的重要项目落地。

 

What We Look For In You

•
6+ years of experience across financial services, FinTech, internet, Crypto/Web3, or related industries.

•
Strong understanding of the broader Web3 ecosystem.

•
Relevant experience across Growth, Product Operations, Business Development, Partnerships, or Ecosystem roles.

•
Strong product and user mindset, with the ability to translate user needs and market opportunities into growth strategies.

•
Excellent commercial communication, partnership management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

•
Ability to independently drive complex initiatives in a global, multicultural, and fast-moving environment.

•
Data-driven, results-oriented, and highly accountable.

Fluent English with the ability to work effectively with global teams and external partners.

6+ 年金融科技、金融服务、互联网、Crypto/Web3 或相关行业经验。

title: Co-Op, Structuring Scientific Data for Discovery
locationText: Cambridge, MA USA; San Francisco, CA USA
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences builds AI systems that accelerate discovery across the physical and life sciences. Our team turns unstructured scientific knowledge, including literature, patents, and technical reports, into structured signals that power downstream Lila applications.

As a Data Extraction Co-Op, you will work alongside research scientists and engineers on a focused sub-problem in this stack. You will fine-tune and evaluate models for scientific knowledge extraction and retrieval, build pipelines for messy real-world data, and ship work that flows into production systems.

What You'll Be Building

• Fine-tune and evaluate language, multimodal, or specialized models for scientific data extraction

• Build retrieval and RAG pipelines surfacing relevant documents, tables, and figures

• Generate and validate structured datasets extracted from scientific literature and patents

• Run end-to-end pipelines and analyze results against clear evaluation criteria

• Document findings and present them to the team

• Contribute to a publication or open-source project where the work supports it

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in CS, chemistry, materials science, physics, biology, or chemical engineering

• Solid foundation in machine learning fundamentals and Python

• Familiarity with NLP or computer vision concepts

• Curiosity about scientific data and willingness to learn quickly in a research setting

• Clear written and verbal communication

Bonus Points For

• Coursework or projects involving multimodal models or document understanding (OCR, table and figure extraction)

• Experience with LLM applications, embeddings, or retrieval systems (chunking, reranking, vector search)

• Experience building evaluation sets or annotation workflows

• Experience working with messy real-world data

• Interest in scientific document parsing

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit enables people to build software with AI. The systems underneath that experience must support safe production changes, measurable reliability, and predictable performance as usage grows.

This Engineering Manager will lead SRE across observability, incident management, load testing, performance engineering, cloud cost and capacity, and rollout infrastructure. You'll lead and grow an existing team that builds and operates production platforms and works hands-on across application and infrastructure boundaries.

This is a software-building leadership role, not simply an incident-management function. You'll help teams ship safely, understand production behavior, and remove performance bottlenecks through concrete engineering improvements. You should be comfortable going deep on a rollout failure or performance investigation while developing technical leaders and sustainable ownership across a distributed team.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Observability. Build and operate metrics, logs, traces, and alerting capabilities. Help teams establish meaningful SLOs and use production telemetry to diagnose problems and verify improvements.

- Incident Management. Own incident tooling and practices, coordinate cross-team response, and turn incident reviews into engineering improvements that reduce recovery time and repeat failures.

- Load Testing. Build and maintain load/failure testing capabilities. Validate critical paths under expected demand, quantify headroom, and test recovery and production readiness with service owners.

- Performance Engineering. Lead deep engagements with internal teams on SLOs and end-to-end performance. Use profiling, telemetry, and load tests to identify bottlenecks and deliver improvements with service owners-not just recommendations.

- Stay technically engaged. Review designs and production changes, debug difficult failure modes, and use AI coding tools-including Replit-to prototype and automate. Apply rigorous review and verification to AI-generated changes.

- Build and grow a high-ownership engineering team. Coach engineers, develop technical leaders, manage performance, and hire against agreed needs. Make distributed collaboration, mentoring, and backup coverage deliberate rather than relying on a few permanent escalation points.

- Measure outcomes and close the loop. Track rollout safety, recovery time, repeat incidents, critical-path latency/throughput, test coverage, and improvements arising from cost/capacity analysis. Agree success measures and continuing ownership with partner teams.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Demonstrated engineering management. You have led and developed engineers, made prioritization and performance decisions, hired thoughtfully, and delivered through a team-not only acted as its strongest individual contributor.

- Software-oriented production systems depth. You have built and operated distributed systems or reliability platforms and can reason across deployment behavior, Kubernetes, telemetry, service dependencies, and recovery mechanisms.

- Safe-change and performance judgment. You have led consequential migrations or incidents and used measurement to diagnose reliability or performance problems. You can distinguish symptoms from causes and validate fixes under realistic conditions.

- Platform-product and cross-team judgment. You can build capabilities other teams adopt, lead hands-on engagements without absorbing every service's operations, and make clear tradeoffs among reliability, performance, engineering effort, and cost.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with GitOps or progressive-delivery platforms such as Harness, ArgoCD, or Kargo.

- Experience with observability, profiling, load-testing, and failure-testing syst

title: Senior Bioinformatics Scientist
description:
Natera is seeking a Senior Bioinformatics Scientist to join our Bioinformatics team dedicated to early cancer detection. As a core member of the Research and Development department, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing innovative computational solutions. The ideal candidate possesses a robust background in algorithm development, high-throughput biological data analysis, and scalable pipeline architecture. We are looking for a versatile professional capable of thriving as an individual contributor, a collaborative co-developer, and a key participant in large-scale, cross-departmental initiatives. In this role, you will develop novel algorithms and pipelines while analyzing complex genomic datasets to advance the frontiers of early-stage cancer diagnostics.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Innovate, design, develop, and validate advanced algorithms and statistical models to extract actionable insights from large-scale genomic datasets for early cancer detection.

• Co-architect, implement, and deploy automated analysis workflows for clinical diagnostics, ensuring robust performance for variant calling, fusion detection, and automated quality control.

• Contribute to rigorous code reviews, maintain comprehensive technical documentation, and drive the continuous optimization of core computational infrastructure.

• Analyze complex multi-omic data using high-performance internal pipelines, collaborating closely with wet-lab scientists and statisticians to meet critical research milestones.

QUALIFICATIONS :

• Ph.D. in Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Statistics, Cancer Biology, or a related quantitative field.

• 0-3 years of professional or postgraduate experience in bioinformatics or computational biology.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

• Excellent communication skills with a demonstrated ability to present complex computational findings to diverse cross-functional stakeholders.

• Deep expertise in high-throughput DNA sequencing (NGS) analysis, including sequence alignment, mapping, and clinical-grade variant calling.

• A proven track record of developing state-of-the-art, high-impact bioinformatics methodologies.

• Advanced knowledge of data structures, algorithm design, and computational complexity analysis.

• High proficiency in Python and its scientific ecosystem (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn) for data manipulation and automation.

• Experience with workflow orchestration languages (WDL preferred) for building and versioning scalable bioinformatics pipelines.

• Experience with cloud-based distributed computing environments, specifically AWS.

• Familiarity with contemporary analytical techniques and biomarkers in cancer biology.

• Working knowledge of public genomic databases such as TCGA, COSMIC, or OncoKB.

• Proficiency in Linux environments, including command-line tools and shell scripting.

The Cloud Infrastructure team builds and operates the infrastructure behind OpenAI’s products, including ChatGPT and the API. Within Cloud Infrastructure, the Traffic team owns how traffic enters our cloud environments, moves between services, clusters, and regions, and reaches external dependencies.

Our work spans cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, ingress and egress gateways, proxies, load balancing, and traffic steering. We build the systems, controls, and observability that make these paths reliable, secure, efficient, and straightforward for other engineering teams to use.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You’ll build and operate the networking and traffic infrastructure that connects OpenAI’s products and services across clouds and regions. The team’s work spans L3, L4, and L7-from IP connectivity, NAT, and transport behavior to service proxies and application request routing.

You’ll bring depth in part of this stack and curiosity about how the whole path works. Projects may include building gateways and control planes, improving cross-region connectivity, diagnosing packet loss or connection exhaustion, and making routing changes safer and easier to operate.

This role combines software engineering with production ownership. You’ll turn ambiguous networking problems into durable improvements, working closely with service owners, infrastructure teams, Security, and cloud providers.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA or Seattle, WA.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Design, build, and operate ingress, egress, and service-to-service connectivity across clusters, regions, and clouds.

- Develop proxies, gateways, controllers, and automation for routing, load balancing, failover, and traffic management.

- Build and evolve cloud networking infrastructure, including private connectivity, NAT, and network isolation.

- Diagnose failures and performance bottlenecks across application, proxy, transport, and cloud networking layers; work with cloud providers when issues extend into their infrastructure.

- Build telemetry and diagnostic tools that explain traffic paths, identify failing components, and help engineers take effective action.

- Partner with Security to implement and validate traffic-path protections, including secure service communication, access controls, egress restrictions, and DDoS defenses.

- Improve latency, throughput, availability, and network efficiency through measurement, testing, and careful production rollouts.

- Create clear interfaces and safe defaults for service teams, participate in on-call, and turn operational lessons into changes that prevent recurring failures and reduce manual work.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have 5+ years of experience building production infrastructure or distributed systems, including substantial work on networking or traffic infrastructure.

- Have depth in one or more areas such as cloud networking, Kubernetes networking, proxies and gateways, service meshes, load balancing, or global traffic routing.

- Understand networking fundamentals and can reason about how IP routing, TCP/UDP, DNS, NAT, TLS, and HTTP/gRPC affect connectivity and performance.

- Have hands-on experience building or operating systems such as Envoy, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, or comparable networking infrastructure.

- Write production software in Go, Rust, C++, Python, or a similar language, and use software and automation to solve operational problems.

- Can investigate unfamiliar failures using evidence, test hypotheses, and follow problems through to a verified resolution.

- Take ownership of design, implementation, rollout, and ongoing reliability, and communicate clearly across teams when a problem crosses ownership boundaries.

- Care about making infrastructure secure and understandable for the engineers who depend on it.

We value deep expertise and the willingness to learn across boundaries. You do not need prior experience with every technology or networking lay
